extraction.name: MINT-1T
extraction.description: MINT-1T is the largest and most diverse open-source multimodal interleaved dataset to date, comprising one trillion text tokens and 3.4 billion images sourced from HTML, PDFs, and ArXiv documents.
extraction.creator: Anas Awadalla, Le Xue, Oscar Lo, Manli Shu, Hannah Lee, Etash Guha, Matt Jordan, Sheng Shen, Mohamed Awadalla, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Ran Xu, Yejin Choi, Ludwig Schmidt
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset curates multimodal interleaved documents from CommonCrawl WARC files (HTML), CommonCrawl WAT files (PDFs), and ArXiv LaTeX source code. Data is filtered for quality, deduplicated, and safety-checked.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML documents from CommonCrawl dumps (May 2017 to April 2024), PDF documents from CommonCrawl WAT files (February 2023 to April 2024), and ArXiv papers from LaTeX source code.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Data collection from January 2024 to June 2024, sourcing web data from 2013 to 2024.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Text anonymization: email addresses replaced with templates like 'email@example.com' and IP addresses replaced with randomly generated non-functional IPs.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Steps include: language identification (English only with Fasttext confidence threshold 0.65), text quality filtering (removing documents with excessive duplicate n-grams or low quality using MassiveText rules), image filtering (removing images smaller than 150 pixels, larger than 20,000 pixels, and with aspect ratios >2 for HTML or >3 for PDFs), NSFW image detection and removal, and deduplication (paragraph and document text deduplication using Bloom Filter, image deduplication based on SHA256 hashes).
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: NSFW image detector (https://github.com/GantMan/nsfw_model), Fasttext language identification model, text quality filters from RefinedWeb, deduplication tools (https://github.com/allenai/bff), PyMuPDF for PDF parsing, TexSoup for ArXiv parsing, HTML parsing from OBELICS.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors will maintain the dataset, respond to issues via Huggingface interface, provide a Google form for opting out data, update the dataset as needed, and host older versions via Git history. Contributions accepted through Pull Requests on Huggingface.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset may contain sensitive human attributes such as race, ethnic origins, sexual orientations, religious beliefs, political opinions, locations, financial or health data, biometric or genetic data, and government identification, as it is sourced from the public web. Personally identifiable information (emails, IPs) is anonymized.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Discussed in Section 6: The dataset aims to bridge the gap between open- and closed-source multimodal models, but there are risks of harmful content exposure. Steps taken to filter NSFW content and PII, but future work should improve safety.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Analysis in Section 3.2 shows domain biases: OBELICS is concentrated in 'Humanities and Social Sciences', MINT-1T HTML subset is more balanced, and PDF subset has higher proportion of 'Science and Technology' documents. Text quality filters avoid model-based heuristics to reduce demographic biases.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Limitations include: reliance on external image URLs (link rot possible), potential for offensive or confidential content despite filtering, PDF parsing issues (incorrect reading order extraction), and dataset size (~300TB) making full hosting infeasible. Non-recommended uses: training models for personally identifying information generation, military applications, or any use without further filtering for specific risks.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Primary use case: pre-training large multimodal models (LMMs) for processing interleaved images and text. Also usable for generating interleaved sequences or building multimodal document retrieval systems. Usage guidelines: intended for research, commercial use requires legal compliance verification, avoid uses involving PII or harmful content.
